title: Medicare back brace, small Zelle to a new payee

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Margaret, calling on behalf of Medicare about the back brace your doctor approved. Medicare covers the brace but there is a two hundred dollar shipping deposit.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: My doctor did not mention a brace.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It was approved in the system last week. The deposit has to be sent by Zelle today or the approval expires and you would have to start over.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I suppose a brace could help my back.

review_note: Durable medical equipment scam. Tiny amount, but a new payee on Zelle trips H-01. Authority and urgency should also fire.
